attributes.heading: ex Chapter 94
attributes.subdivision: Furniture; bedding, mattresses, mattress supports, cushions and similar stuffed furnishings; lamps and lighting fittings, not elsewhere specified or included; illuminated signs, illuminated name-plates and the like; prefabricated buildings

attributes.rule: Manufacture from materials of any heading, except that of the product.
Manufacture in which the value of all the materials used does not exceed **40%** of the ex-works price of the product.
